metadata.description: A software factory for Claude Code: issue in, reviewed pull request out.

plugins.name: code-factory
plugins.description: Turns a Jira issue (or a local task) into reviewed pull requests: intake, spec with test data, build, gate with checks, UI checks and security scans, verified reviews, approver, self-learning. Project-, stack- and language-agnostic; each project gets its own factory repository for all its repositories, and they are only touched through pull requests.
